changes: Added one typed agent dispatch registry shared by schema, prompt routing, lifecycle hints, reviewer-lane evidence and all role-gated mutation handlers. Unknown roles and identity spoofing now fail closed; story-only versus exactly-one help is accurate; legacy verification aliases remain verification-only.
usage: Run lattice dispatch with storyId and a registered agentType, using no identifier for story-only roles or the registry-required itemId, findingId, or clusterId for exactly-one roles. Lattice dispatch help explains conditional cardinality.
expectedOutcome: The registry diagnostic enumerates every supported canonical role and alias and rejects incomplete, unknown, wrong-phase, wrong-cardinality or unauthorized mutation attempts before side effects.
actualTranscript: Live machine transcript exited 0 with agent-dispatch-registry-smoke PASS for 14 canonical roles and 2 aliases. Routine validation passed all 45 configured commands; delivery review verified 7 of 7 documentation promises.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible difference from the expected outcome; the final transcript and enforcement behavior match the plan.
limitations: A separate item-reviewer is intentionally folded into quality, behavior and verification-intent roles. Routine validate fresh-PASS reuse is not part of this story and will be handled by the next independent story.
pitfalls: Six review rounds exposed unknown-actor, trusted-host and env-versus-payload spoofing layers. Candidate artifacts must be refreshed once by the owner, not concurrently by reviewers. TEST initially failed only because verification evidence hashes were stale; refresh evidence before routine validate to avoid a redundant full run.
